drumCircle.title: Drum Circle
about: West African djembe drums put rhythm in every pair of hands. From simple beats to intricate patterns, the session builds bonding and a positive mood — a stress buster and morale booster in one.
There is no sheet music and no wrong note. The facilitator cues sections, shifts the tempo and brings everyone together for a finale.

philosophy.title: Taal is rhythm. Yatra is journey. Together, it’s the journey of getting in sync.
philosophy.lead: We believe rhythm is the most welcoming language there is. You don’t need to read music, speak the same language or have played before — you only need to listen, and join in.

pillars.title: Everyone can play
pillars.text: No talent test. A drum, a facilitator and a circle are enough to make anyone feel part of the music.

pillars.title: Listen to belong
pillars.text: Keeping time means tuning in to others. That habit carries back into how teams and families talk.

pillars.title: Joy is shared
pillars.text: Laughter, movement and noise are not a break from connection — they are how connection happens.

items.question: Does anyone need musical experience?
items.answer: No. The facilitator teaches every pattern step by step, so first-timers play alongside confident musicians.

items.question: Do you do family and private events?
items.answer: Yes. We run sessions for birthdays, festivals, family days and friend groups as well as corporate events.

items.question: How big can the group be?
items.answer: Drum Circle runs from 10 to 5,000 people. Other experiences have their own ranges, shown on each card.

items.question: Indoors or outdoors?
items.answer: Most experiences work in both. Harmonica and Trash Jam are best indoors.

items.question: Can we combine experiences?
items.answer: Yes. Many groups pair a Drum Circle with Body Percussion or Boombastic. Tell us your schedule and we will suggest a mix.

replies.text: Pricing depends on group size, venue, date and duration. Use the "Plan your session" builder or message us on WhatsApp for a quick quote.

Sessions run 20 to 60 minutes. Drum Circle is 45 to 60 minutes.
